name: onenote2md
description: Agent-native Markdown note management in the OneNote style. Slash-command system (/init, /newnotebook, /newsection, /newpage). Dynamic templates from your own notes. OneNote migration via /init. Works across Copilot, Claude Code, and Codex.

plugins.name: onenote2md
plugins.description: OneNote-style Markdown note management with unified slash commands. Import from OneNote, auto-learn templates from your notes, archive old content. Works with any agent — Copilot, Claude Code, or Codex.
